purpose: Positive control for future attacks, existing MBA helper normalization only
attacker_input: Binary and its public ABI, no generator or variable map; known MBA identity
primary_metric: Number of exact pure-local MBA instruction patterns restored to i32.add
success_scope: Local expression restoration, not unknown whole-program semantic reconstruction
controls: Plain raw/O2/O3 should have no replacements; failed O3 match is coverage-limited, not resistance
verification: Every recovered binary must pass every saved SHA test; preserve and compare message bytes and rejected-length memory effects
performance: One diagnostic wall time only; no statistical attack-time comparison
memory: Host default, no enforced memory cap; limited six small binaries
novelty: None claimed for this attack or MBA construction
